artifact: AC-137 facilitator-only answer key and scoring protocol
visibility: FACILITATOR_ONLY. This file is never served to a participant, never embedded in the participant surface, and is not part of the participant bundle inventory.

protocol.participants: Exactly five real legal operations managers, corporate transactional partners or senior closing coordinators. Author self-testing, designer testing, internal AI personas and proxy engineers are disqualified.
protocol.materials: Two unseen 50-row synthetic matters, each with a full causal graph, declared milestone prerequisites and scoped owners.
protocol.counterbalancing: Three participants run A then B; two run B then A.
protocol.timing: The timer starts when the Control Room has fully rendered. No hint, prompt or coaching is given.
protocol.threshold: At least four of five participants answer all three questions correctly within ten seconds, in each scenario separately.
protocol.noAveraging: Elapsed time and accuracy are recorded per participant and per scenario. A mean below ten seconds does not rescue an individual failure.
protocol.consent: Formal participant consent is required. No personally identifiable data and no client name is stored in the repository.
